name: press-button
title: Press a button
description: Press an annotated appliance button with the closed fingertips and retract: the microwave door key, the microwave start key, or the stove power key (which toggles the burner).
use_when: A button (microwave keys, stove power key) must be pressed.

not_to_be_confused_with.heat: heat guarantees a temperature; press guarantees only the key press.
not_to_be_confused_with.open: open guarantees the door is open.

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right); base_near(place=@button.appliance). Depending on the bound nouns, the chosen path also needs: microwave_start_staged (button.button == 'start_button'): is_closed(articulated=@button.appliance).

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: button_pressed
postconditions.meaning: A measured press of this button happened during the Contract.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: hand_empty
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: button_pressed
checks.meaning: A measured press of this button happened during the Contract.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: hand_empty
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: heating
checks.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_preconditions.name: is_closed
extra_preconditions.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

extra_postconditions.name: heating
extra_postconditions.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

next.when: the start key began a cycle

alternative.when: the door key is pressed only to open the microwave door

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
